required_v7_properties: derive the Influence replay floor from six exact identity-bound replay-pair outputs rather than a caller scalar
derive Localization placebo tails from bound effect, support and exact ordered mask evidence rather than caller mappings
prove every reference capture is distinct from the target answer and absent from every memory, conditioning and model-input roster
use one finite replacement selector covering scene, camera, support IoU, area ratio, quality stratum, recency, validity and full inclusion/exclusion flow
state RCSU as comparator-relative unless a separately valid same-path source-absence intervention is added
bind common-valid, hole, view-pair and identity evidence to exact required roles and mask hashes
derive the complete family-by-sign-by-seed-by-target-by-replacement grid, stage order, conjunction and terminal kill action
reject non-real scalar types and bind every scientific output to exact data identity
additional_v4_intervention_requirements: register at least one in-distribution matched replacement and a same-path dose-zero for every primary edit family
preserve source count, tensor shape, layout, temporal position, selector roster, RNG and all non-target pre-treatment state
bind intervention-validity and distribution-shift receipts before any endpoint state is accepted
treat drop, deletion, unmatched zero and scramble as OOD stress tests outside the primary estimand
recompute every target-source descendant for total-effect claims
fail the primary claim if no natural-distribution-matched intervention can be validated

reference_roster_requirements.selection_time: before any Stage C model output or endpoint result is inspected
reference_roster_requirements.more_than_three_policy: use every eligible reference in canonical capture-id order; no result-dependent subset
reference_roster_requirements.held_out: each exact capture hash must be absent from model input, memory, conditioning, target-answer and replacement rosters
reference_roster_requirements.identity: capture, sensor, timestamp, target, camera, pose, intrinsics and file SHA must be bound
reference_roster_requirements.common_validity: recompute from exact role-labelled validity masks for every O/R or O/R/P comparison
reference_roster_requirements.uncertainty: Delta_ref and Delta_U are engineering floors, not bounds on shared systematic reference bias

required_exact_fields: reviewer role distinct from S48 V7 author
zero real arms, model runs and image reads during source review
future_binding_gate.effect_on_this_package: binding V7 changes this file and therefore requires a new RAIMA freeze and fresh review
